verdict.rationale: The only evidence of running AgentMail outside its hosted service is a community report that its enterprise options include "Bring Your Own Cloud". That suggests deployment into a customer's own cloud, but no first-party documentation describes it. The open-source MIT SDKs are client libraries, not the core product, and earn no credit. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of a self-hosted or BYOC deployment, availability outside enterprise contracts, an open-source or downloadable core server, deployment and installation guides, and hands-on corroboration that customers actually run it themselves.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
